description: AI-generated illustrative scene, not a photograph of an actual client workshop.
prompt:
Photographic compositing edit. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL donor photograph of Max; image 2 is the workshop scene to edit.

Transfer the actual head from image 1 onto the central man in image 2, as close to an unchanged photographic cutout as possible. Use image 1 as the ONLY source of facial identity. Keep its exact three-quarter head angle, original natural tooth-showing smile, mouth and tooth shapes, eyes, eyebrows, nose, jaw, cheeks, skin texture, blue glasses, ears and hair. Preserve the original expression; do not substitute a listening expression, soften the smile or invent a new face. Do not blend facial features with the generated man from image 2.

Treat the donor head as one intact photographic object: only uniform scaling, translation and a slight rigid rotation for placement, no stretching, morphing, reshaping, beautification or reinterpretation of features. Favor the donor head's real proportions and orientation. Fit the neck and collar underneath it naturally rather than distorting the donor face to fit the old pose. Match the head's scale to a realistically proportioned seated adult body. Use only subtle overall exposure/color adjustment if needed for the room; preserve the donor's facial details and expression.

Keep the central man's approved white crewneck sweater, jeans and seated position. Keep the four other people, their gestures, room, chairs, background, light, framing and all other scene elements unchanged. Only the central head and the narrow neck-to-collar joining area may change. Same opaque landscape 3:2 output. No text or logos.
